result.topic_en: Calculations for Riemann's rotating fluid ellipsoid: equations of motion for the time-dependent quantities associated with the semi-axes a, b, c, integral expressions for the gravitational potential coefficients, and algebraic elimination of the parameters λ, μ, ν.

methods.what: Equations of motion: first-order ODE system in time for rotation/vorticity parameters coupled to semi-axis differences and sums
Steady-state conditions as algebraic equations in ratios λ, μ, ν
Gravitational potential coefficients of the ellipsoid as elliptic-type integrals
Relation of potential integrals to rotation and vorticity parameters ω, ω₁
Introduction of auxiliary quantities α, β, γ to parametrize λ, μ, ν
Linear relation among λ, μ, ν derived from elimination
Invariant relation among α, β, γ and semi-axes
Special case u'=0 leads to b=c
Quadratic combination of u,v,w equals ω²−ω₁²
